protocol: memory-advantage supervised state-conditioned K+V gate, layers 12-23

naive_balanced_action_label_control.interpretation: Treating every non-critical action prefix as zero memory advantage collapses localization because memory can be causally useful for a later decision even when the current action is harmless.

conclusion: Explicit memory supervision can create a large cue-vs-distractor gate gap, but action-critical labels are not valid negative memory labels. The next dataset must estimate each block with Q(M)-Q(M^-j) over future continuations.
